description: This file defines a React-like component 'RouterHead' that manages the content of the document's `<head>` element, dynamically inserting title, meta tags, links, styles, and scripts based on the application's document head state.

methods.name: RouterHead
methods.description: A component$ that returns JSX to manage document head elements such as title, meta, links, styles, and scripts based on the current document head state and location.
